text:
The mood conveyed in the text is one of lazy, sweltering nostalgia. The description of the heat sinking into bones and the thick humidity creates a heavy, immersive atmosphere, while the scent of honeysuckle and the drone of cicadas evoke a sensory richness typical of a slow summer afternoon. The distant laughter of children adds a layer of carefree joy, contrasting with the oppressive heat to create a sense of timeless, simpler days.

Regarding the specific question asked within the text: The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.
